property_summary: After updateRoundImplementation, the stored roundImplementation getter is never the zero address: the reference reverts on address(0) (leaving the previously set nonzero value), while the mutant accepts address(0) and leaves roundImplementation() == 0x0.
change_summary: Remove the zero-address require, so calling updateRoundImplementation(address(0)) sets roundImplementation to 0x0 instead of reverting.
